items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He played the clarinet so well, until Pete Lawley used to hire him out there for a dollar a night to play on Iberville, Murray, that night.

ctx.x: In the late years he played the soprano sax more than he did clarinet. Than he did clarinet. Did he play clarinet mostly here or the other?

Well he was brought up on the clarinet more than the soprano. He picked the soprano up afterwards. He was great on the clarinet. Well he played a flute first, a little fifteen cents flute, six-hole flute. That's why he learned to play, on a little fifteen cents flute. He played that flute so well they gave him a clarinet. They gave him one. And he played the clarinet so well, until Pete Lawley used to hire him out there for a dollar a night to play on Iberville, Murray, that night. He played up there in short…
Was he really good in those days when he was a boy?
